resources.string: A cozy orange tabby that reacts to phone tilt, greets you when you unlock, and flicks her tail while she naps.
OFF = soft stop: wallpaper stays applied but freezes (sensors + animations off)
No idle animations, slower sensor polling
Tip: tilt your phone, or tap the preview to see the wake animation
Couldn\'t open the wallpaper picker — set it from Settings → Wallpaper and style

Widget/tile toggle is a SOFT stop — the cat freezes in place and stops using sensors; one tap brings her back.\n\nForce Stop (Settings → Apps) or swiping the app away is a HARD stop — Android reverts to your previous static wallpaper and you re-select this one to bring the cat back.
